response.justification: The candidate is a highly experienced, versatile software engineer, but his recent decade of work is overwhelmingly focused on TypeScript/Node.js, JavaScript, and web/mobile platforms rather than C++. His only substantial C++ experience is a brief stint in 2014-2015 writing C/C++ components, over a decade ago, with no evidence of STL, multi-threading, message brokers, MQTT, REST, IEC 62443, or industrial automation experience. This is a poor match for a role centered on architecting high-performance C++ systems for industrial automation with strict secure-development standards.
strengths: Extensive, diverse software engineering background spanning 15+ years
Demonstrated experience with distributed systems, async I/O, and high-performance code (in DLang, not C++)
Strong communication, mentoring, and documentation skills evidenced by talks and workshops
concerns: Minimal and outdated C++ experience (roughly one year, over 10 years ago)
No evidence of MQTT, message brokers, IEC 62443, or industrial automation/IoT protocol experience
Recent career trajectory is firmly in web/full-stack (TypeScript/Node.js), not systems-level C++ development

key_factors.factor: No industrial cybersecurity (IEC 62443) or SDL experience
No MQTT/IoT/message-broker or industrial protocol experience
